WHAT_THIS_IS: Per-model scores of the three stimulus texts themselves, under every final checkpoint. EXPLORATORY -- none of this is pre-registered. Three probes: per-token loss over the injected region of the exact sequence the run saw; hand-written minimal-pair continuations for each asserted fact; and log P(surname | given name), the smallest thing that could survive one exposure.
NOTE_EVERY_MODEL_SCORED_ON_EVERY_TEXT: Each of the 32 models is scored on all three stimulus texts, not only its own. That is what makes the difference-in-differences possible: improvement on a text is only evidence of learning if the models that did NOT see it fail to show it.
